tldr: Headlines overwhelmingly foreground Russia's drone barrage on Kyiv, with a recurrent 'after Trump talks' subordinate clause advertising diplomatic failure. A smaller thread leads with Ukraine's own 1,000-drone counter-strike on Moscow, most visible in US and Indian outlets.

single_outlet_findings.finding: Only headline to lead with a causal diplomatic-failure frame ('do little to reign in') rather than describing the attacks themselves — an interpretive editorial angle absent from all factual-baseline outlets.
Only headline to situate Ukraine's 1,000-drone strike against the backdrop of Russia's final election day, implying deliberate tactical timing.
Only headline to cover the structural escalation trend (eightfold jet-drone increase since June) rather than a specific incident — a systemic rather than episodic frame.

bottom_line: Headline coverage leads with Russia's Kyiv drone barrage; the 'after Trump talks' construction recurs across wire and Western outlets, pre-advertising the body's diplomatic-failure angle before readers click through.
